screen.hud_config.batch_loot_beams.toolt: Draws all loot beams, glows and their particles together, one draw per kind, instead of one beam at a time. Off restores the original drawing.
screen.hud_config.cull_loot_beams.toolti: Does not draw loot beams for items outside your view. Off draws every item within the beam range, as the original did.
screen.hud_config.cache_loot_beam_config: Looks up each item's beam settings once instead of several times every frame. Off restores the original lookup.
screen.hud_config.prune_beam_timers: Tidy beam timers once per frame
screen.hud_config.prune_beam_timers.tool: Clears finished beam grow-in timers once per frame instead of after every beam. Off restores the original.
screen.hud_config.dust_no_collisions.too: The map's dust above dropped items skips block collisions, which it never needs. Off restores the original particles.
screen.hud_config.skip_hidden_faces.tool: Leaves out the faces of dropped items that point away from you before they are drawn. The graphics card throws them away anyway, so nothing looks different. Off draws every face, as the original did.
screen.hud_config.remember_item_bounds.t: Works out the size of each item model once, instead of from every corner of it for every dropped item every frame. Off restores the original.
screen.hud_config.direct_item_outlines.t: Writes the glow outline of dropped items straight into the outline buffer instead of converting every face to it. Same outline, less work. Off restores the original.
screen.hud_config.cache_name_tags.toolti: Builds and lays out each dropped item's name tag once, and reuses it while it stays the same, instead of twice every frame. Off restores the original.
screen.hud_config.light_item_checks.tool: Reads dropped items' data without copying it, and works out beam colours and item tooltips only for the tags that show, instead of for every item every frame. Off restores the original.
screen.hud_config.solid_items.tooltip: Draws dropped items without translucency, which skips sorting them every frame. Semi-transparent pixels (stained glass, some potions) become fully solid or fully clear.
screen.hud_config.loot_beam_limit.toolti: Draws loot beams only on the nearest dropped items you can see. Lower values help when hundreds of items are on the ground.
screen.hud_config.map_item_particles.too: The map adds coloured dust above every dropped item. Keeping it on the nearest items only raises the frame rate around large piles of loot.
screen.hud_config.loot_piles.tooltip: Items lying in the same block show one beam and one set of map particles per rarity, so a pile still shows every rarity it holds. Off gives every item its own.
screen.hud_config.sneak_skips_menus.tool: Hold Sneak while talking to an NPC to get the map's chat menu instead of the mod's window.
